next_stage: M11.1 coverage-preserving active inspection before M12 workflow improvement
reason: Current fixed-budget PPO does not beat the feasible fixed tour; guard effects depend on resources; all main fixed-tour misses are shorter than300s

tasks.objective: Define which observations can validly complete each task
deliverables: Calibrated telemetry versus professional reference-task capability matrix
Explicit known-inventory scope; undiscovered equipment or unknown-area exploration requires a separately defined discovery task
Voltage, current and supply-availability tasks with explicit completion semantics
Dedicated electrical-contact and feeder-fault validation conditions
Revisit and staffing assumptions tied to stated synthetic or expert evidence
tasks.gate: Do not require an unnecessary mobile visit for a remotely verifiable task; do not call a service-power gap confirmed just because contact heat was normal

tasks.objective: Preserve a verified recurrent coverage schedule while allowing active detours
deliverables: Explicit baseline tour and remaining-slack representation
Candidate detour acceptance checked against a complete feasible return schedule
Fallback actions when no justified detour fits
Exact event-time revisit gaps reported separately from sampled inspection ages
Tests for initial backlog, access restrictions, simultaneous reservations and service-time quantization
tasks.gate: A heuristic age threshold is not a guarantee; use an independently checked certificate or state the exact empirical scope

tasks.objective: Measure active-checking benefit for short and transient anomalies
deliverables: Engineering meaning of actionable transient anomalies distinguished from harmless threshold crossings; no post-hoc relabeling of current M11 outcomes
Same resource and calibrated observation permissions for all comparators
Extra checking driven by measurement age, estimator disagreement and validated alert information
First discovery, persistent-event recheck and recovery confirmation recorded separately; predeclared reward interventions for repeated confirmations
New training, validation and untouched test seeds, with sensor-error and duration shifts
tasks.gate: No online access to true anomaly onset or hidden duration; finite visit capacity cannot be presented as guaranteeing detection of every arbitrarily brief event

tasks.objective: Separate rule, learning and estimator effects
comparators: Matched heuristic with the same coverage-preserving gate
Untrained score network with the same gate
New policy trained with the gate
Separate policy trained without the gate
Nominal physical versus frozen history-estimator controls
tasks.gate: Freeze budgets and validation selection before new tests; current M11 tests become diagnostic material, not a fresh holdout

later_M12.objective: Use an open language model to improve skills, tool selection and collaboration workflows on a reliable frozen task layer
later_M12.prototype: Bounded declarative workflow proposals; simulation truth and test labels remain evaluator-only
comparators: Updated improver evaluated on independent cases
later_M12.gate: Distinguish improved task workflows from recursive improvement of the improver itself; do not call the present PPO benchmark RSI
